text: Gold in India went from three thousand rupees to over one lakh. But it crashed many times on the way. Here is every big fall, every big jump, and why.
Nineteen ninety one. India was almost bankrupt and the rupee crashed. Gold jumped twenty five percent in one year, even though the world price fell.
Then India opened gold imports. Smuggling lost its edge, the black market premium vanished, and gold fell almost five percent.

Nineteen ninety seven to two thousand one. Europe's central banks were dumping gold. In July ninety nine, world gold hit two hundred fifty two dollars, a twenty year low. India's price went nowhere for five years.
Then the big run. The two thousand eight crisis, and the US printing money. In eleven years, gold went from about forty six hundred to thirty thousand rupees.
Twenty thirteen. The US Fed said it would slow money printing. That was the taper tantrum. World gold fell twenty nine percent that year, and India's price slid for three years.
Twenty twenty. Covid. Near zero rates and huge stimulus. Gold crossed two thousand dollars for the first time, and India's price jumped thirty two percent.
Then wars, and central banks buying gold like never before. Eight hundred sixty three tonnes in twenty twenty five alone. India's average price crossed one lakh eighteen thousand.
And now, another fall. Since November ninth, a strong dollar and a tough talking Fed have pulled M C X gold down almost fourteen percent.
The pattern? Gold rises on fear, a weak dollar and a falling rupee. It falls when the dollar is strong and rates go up. Save this, and follow money in cloud.
